task: cme-2019-2021 — CME Group published holiday schedules for calendar years 2019, 2020 and 2021, per product group (Equity Index incl. Nikkei note, Interest Rates, FX, Energy/Metals, Grains & Oilseeds, Livestock, Cryptocurrency, plus the Dairy and Lumber lines printed on the same sheets).
coverage:
COMPLETE for 2019, 2020 and 2021. Every U.S. holiday for which CME Group published a Globex holiday schedule in those three years is sourced at tier T1 from CME's own documents.

ENUMERATION FIRST (as instructed). Internet Archive CDX was run over four prefixes and saved under raw/cme-2019-2021/: cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar* (cdx-hc.json), .../holiday-calendar/files/ as matchType=prefix (cdx-files.json), cmegroup.com/trading-hours* (cdx-tradinghours.json), and the snapshots of holiday-calendar.html itself (cdx-hcpage.json). Four archived copies of holiday-calendar.html (2019-12-06, 2020-03-26, 2020-04-20, 2020-06-11) were then retrieved and their hrefs extracted: those pages are CME's own index of which holiday documents existed each year, and they are what proved that 2020 had a consolidated ZIP and named the exact filenames for the 2020 MLK / Presidents' Day / Good Friday sheets that the CDX index alone did not surface.

CONSOLIDATED ANNUAL DOCUMENTS. CME published one ZIP per year, and each ZIP sources every holiday in its year:
  2019-holiday-calendars.zip  (archive capture 2021-01-26T09:48:37Z; 18 Globex schedule .xls + 11 settlement-notice PDFs; members dated 2019-10-23) sha256 1e861e355238903b013c1288f4eb9e8026e6ddd5fc1001dfd2acdbfcc1832e05
  2020-holiday-calendars.zip  (id_ replay via /web/2021id_/; 18 .xls; members dated 2020-12-29) sha256 5263a4a5e9076bc0e69c7cd0e3fd9f82dc4d80b66f1b56f14070f08c1d762b59
  2021-holiday-calendars.zip  (id_ replay via /web/2022id_/; 18 .xls; members dated 2022-01-03) sha256 0ee0860a3a0e035eb9d079419aca3cafcc4256d296fa916647987c396dda8c59
Individually captured copies of 26 of the same per-holiday sheets were also downloaded (raw/cme-2019-2021/docs/, manifest in list.txt) and agree with the ZIP members.

ONE SUPPLEMENT. Each year's "new years" sheet covers 31 Dec of that year into January of the NEXT year, so 1 January 2019 is governed by the December-2018 document, retrieved separately: 2019-new-years-holiday-schedule-compact.xls, archive capture 2018-01-07T04:13:43Z, sha256 2684a5f1b3a9f65802f6911ca6089e2cb68c3cdf2520dfaf3cdcf3105328c188, title verbatim "CME Group Globex New Years Holiday Schedule: December 31, 2018 - January 2, 2019".

RETRIEVAL. cmegroup.com returns 403 to this machine, so every artifact was read through the Internet Archive raw-replay form https://web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/<url>. All retrievals performed 2026-09-12 UTC. Bytes, text dumps, sha256 manifest and INDEX.md are under /Users/agedvagabond/Developer/exchange-hours-research/holidays/raw/cme-2019-2021/. Each .xls is a real BIFF workbook, read with xlrd (dumper saved as dumpxls.py; per-sheet plain-text dumps in text/).

ZONE AS PRINTED. These sheets print Central Time with UTC — the full sheets carry the header "All times are Central Time   ET +1  UTC  +5" (or "+6" in winter), and the compact sheets print each cell as e.g. "Regular @ 1600 CT / 2200 UTC". ET appears only in the TAS/TAM notes, where CME prints "CT / ET" (e.g. "Gold TAS - Early close 1130 CT / 1230 ET"). Both forms are quoted verbatim in the rows; no instant was converted or inferred.

NOTATION IN `verbatim`. Each string is the group's own row as CME prints it, cells separated by ' | '; an ellipsis (…) marks cells of that same row omitted here for length — the untruncated per-sheet text is in raw/cme-2019-2021/text/. GROUP LABELS AS CME PRINTS THEM. Compact sheets: Equity; Bitcoin (renamed Cryptocurrency in the 2021 full sheets); Interest Rate; FX; "Energy, Metals & DME"; "Grain & Oilseed"; Mini-Grain; MGEX Wheat / MGEX Indices; Dairy; "Lumber Futures&Options"; Livestock. Full sheets use "Equity Products", "Interest Rate Products", "FX Products", "Energy, Metals, Softs & DME Products", "Grain, Oilseed & MGEX Products". Dairy and Lumber are printed on the same sheet and are included here as dairy_same_page / lumber_same_page. globex_energy carries the single "Energy, Metals & DME" line because CME states NYMEX energy and COMEX metals on one row.

NIKKEI. None of these sheets prints an outright Nikkei row; the Nikkei 225 futures fall under the "Equity"/"Equity Products" line, and the only Nikkei-labelled row is a BTIC trade-type exception ("Nikkei/TOPIX BTIC"). Each globex_nikkei_225_dollar row therefore quotes both the BTIC row and the Equity line it follows, and says so explicitly. Two 2021 sheets are different and are marked status=modified: 2021 Good Friday splits "Nikkei BTIC" from "TOPIX BTIC", and 2021 Thanksgiving prints "Nikkei & BTIC" with its own 10:30 pre-open / 11:00 open / 16:00 halt and 00:00 close.

CRYPTOCURRENCY. Bitcoin has a line on every sheet from 2019 onward, so globex_cryptocurrency is sourced for all three years.

NOTABLE PER-GROUP DIFFERENCES FOUND (not pattern-inferred — each is read off its own sheet): 3 July 2019 only Equity and Bitcoin closed early (12:15 CT) while Interest Rate, FX and Energy/Metals closed regular at 16:00 CT; 2 July 2020 all five of those closed regular and only the ags closed early; Good Friday 2021 was a partial session (Equity and Cryptocurrency closed 08:15 CT / 1315 UTC, Interest Rate and FX closed 10:15 CT / 1515 UTC, Energy/Metals/Grains/Livestock/Lumber/Dairy closed all day), unlike Good Friday 2019 and 2020 which were full closures for every group; the Friday after Thanksgiving 2021 put Cryptocurrency at 12:45 CT while Equity/Rates/FX stayed 12:15 CT.

HOLIDAYS WITH NO CME SCHEDULE IN THESE YEARS. Juneteenth: CME published no Juneteenth holiday schedule for 2019, 2020 or 2021 — the archived holiday-calendar.html file lists for those years contain no juneteenth document, and the first is 2022-juneteenth-advisory.pdf / 2022-juneteenth-holiday-schedule.xls. Columbus Day and Veterans Day: CME published only settlement-time and OTC-clearing advisories for these, never a Globex trading schedule, so Globex ran normally; those PDFs are settlement language, not session language, and were not used to key any row (LAW-SESSION-NOT-EXPIRY).

NOT USED AS EVIDENCE. The settlement-notices/*-settlement-times.pdf and *-otc-advisory.pdf members inside the ZIPs state settlement and OTC clearing times, not session boundaries; they are retained in the research store but key nothing.

DOCUMENT-ID LEGEND. Each row's `document` is a short code for the CME sheet it was read from. Expand it as: <year>-<holiday>[(DEC2018)], where the sheet is the "compact" Globex holiday schedule for that holiday, taken from CME's own consolidated annual ZIP:
  codes starting 2019- -> https://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar/files/2019-holiday-calendars.zip#globex-trading-schedules/  (IA id_ replay, capture 2021-01-26T09:48:37Z)
  codes starting 2020-, and 2021-ny -> .../files/2020-holiday-calendars.zip#  (IA id_ replay via /web/2021id_/, members dated 2020-12-29)
  codes starting 2021- (other than 2021-ny) and 2022-ny -> .../files/2021-holiday-calendars.zip#  (IA id_ replay via /web/2022id_/, members dated 2022-01-03)
  2019-ny(DEC2018) -> http://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar/files/2019-new-years-holiday-schedule-compact.xls (IA id_ replay, capture 2018-01-07T04:13:43Z), the sheet titled "December 31, 2018 - January 2, 2019", which governs 1 Jan 2019.
Holiday tokens: mlk, presidents, goodfri, memorial, july4, labor, thx, xmas, ny. Exact member filenames, sha256 of every artifact, and the untruncated per-sheet text are in raw/cme-2019-2021/ (INDEX.md, shasum.txt, text/). Where a row's note cites a full (non-compact) sheet, it is the same-named member without "-compact" in the same ZIP.

missing: Nothing is missing for the eight served CME Group product families across 2019, 2020 and 2021: every holiday CME published a Globex schedule for in those years is sourced at T1.

Juneteenth 2019, 2020, 2021 — all groups: no CME document exists. Channels tried: CDX over cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar* and .../files/ (matchType=prefix, 2018-2023), CDX over cmegroup.com/trading-hours*, and the href lists of four archived holiday-calendar.html snapshots (2019-12-06, 2020-03-26, 2020-04-20, 2020-06-11). No juneteenth filename appears before 2022. Recorded as 'no operator schedule published', not as a status.

Columbus Day and Veterans Day 2019-2021 — all groups: CME published only settlement-time and OTC-clearing advisories (e.g. 2019-columbus-day-holiday-settlement-times.pdf, 2021-veterans-day-advisory.pdf), never a Globex trading schedule. Same channels tried. No session-language document exists, so no row is keyed; the absence of a schedule is CME's own indication that Globex ran normally, but that inference is not recorded as sourced.

globex_nikkei_225_dollar as a distinct outright line — MLK, Presidents' Day, Good Friday (2019, 2020), Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving (2019, 2020), Christmas and New Year, all three years: CME prints no outright Nikkei row on these sheets. The family is recorded as following the quoted 'Equity Products' line, with the 'Nikkei/TOPIX BTIC' exception row quoted beside it. Only 2021 Good Friday and 2021 Thanksgiving print a Nikkei-labelled row of their own. Channels tried: both the compact and the full sheet for every holiday in all three ZIPs.
